title: After the last feeding
description: A bonded living assembly retains softly stained material after its finite feed ends. Gold marks actual mechanical junctions; fluorescence is an optical stain of retained catalyst and bound precursor. Native32³ at time 64. The related16³ trajectory is a separate resolution and state.
